Name: MH Chest Grabber
Author: mahsouto
Description:
[b][size=6]MH Chest Grabber[/size][/b]
Adds a simple "Grab All" button to chest menus that transfers all items from the chest to your inventory in one click. 

[b][size=3]Features[/size][/b]
- UI Button
- Configurable keybind (default: G key)
- Takes as many items as possible if inventory is full
- Works with all chest types
- Button can be hidden via config if you only want the keybind

[b][size=3]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Should work fine alongside other chest/inventory mods like Convenient Inventory and Chests Anywhere. The button automatically positions itself to avoid overlapping with other mod buttons.

Just a simple quality of life improvement for when you need to empty chests quickly.

[size=3][b]Notes [/b][/size][list]
[*]The description has been translated from Spanish.
[/list]
